description: Rieckermann, Jörg at Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology publishes paired sewer-flow measurements from DischargeKeeper and Nivus sensors through Co-UDlabs. The experimental Eawag HALL combined-sewer site compares surface-structure image velocimetry with ultrasonic measurements. Timestamped flow, depth and velocity records include raw and quality-checked series, with 2019 periods named in the native file inventory. Coverage is the Dübendorf experimental sewer in Switzerland; January and April–May 2019 are identified. Zenodo provides a ZIP containing CSV measurements, analysis scripts and documentation with free access under CC 0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is the metadata do not quantify agreement, define every quality flag or establish complete coverage across 2019. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
